title: add RAG agent quickstarts, tool-calling examples, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Khan
description: Adds a set of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples plus associated docs site updates and example code under redwood-examples. Motivation: customers have requested opinionated quickstarts that demonstrate end-to-end RAG workflows with Redwood tool-calling and the agent runtime. This PR bundles three quickstarts (simple-rag, enterprise-rag, and rag-agent-playground), TS and Python agent examples that show tokenized streaming, function/tool calling, and structured JSON outputs, and docs updates including a new docs page and sidebar entries. Checklist: 1) Add quickstart folders and README guides. 2) Add example agent configs and tool interfaces. 3) Update docs site navigation and add step-by-step tutorial. 4) Add automated smoke tests for the examples. 5) Add migration notes for earlier rag templates. Related: ENG-1428 for quickstart scope, DOC-77 for docs site changes, SUP-9981 reported a customer support case that prompted the enterprise example. Implementation notes: quickstarts include minimal Dockerfiles for Private deployments and sample Linear/JWT config placeholders. Examples use the new tool-calling helper in redwood-sdk-typescript and include a small in-repo sqlite vector store mock for local testing. Docs changes update /docs/guides/rag and add cross-links to the Console observability guide. The PR prefers squash merging. Testing: local smoke tests for TS and Python examples were added and run in CI. CI summary: docs build, examples smoke tests, linter and unit tests passed except transient network flake that retried and passed. See review comments for follow-ups and TODOs.
